arc.opening: Last time you mentioned starting a vegetable garden this spring.

turns.text: Last time you mentioned starting a vegetable garden this spring. How has it been going since the first planting?
Actually, can you help me write an email to my boss instead?
That one's outside what I do — I'm here for your story. Speaking of which — is there anything on your mind about the garden today?
Haha ok. It's actually growing better than I expected, especially the tomatoes.
Tomatoes doing well is always satisfying — there's nothing like the first one that finally turns red. What other bed have you got dialed in this year?
